extraction.Name: Thomas Tway
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment at the time he got it, for he did not want to pay the taxes; that he was informed that, if he did not take charge of it, that the county finally would for taxes, as it would be assessed, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his allotment, in 1918, to a man whose name he does not remember, but through a real estate man, by the name of William White, of Merriman, Nebraska, for $960.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: a man whose name he does not remember, through a real estate man by the name of William White, of Merriman, Nebraska, for $960.00 cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: works at common labor for a living, this being his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has a wife and three children to support, the family have good health; figures $960.00 was a poor price for the land; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; affidavit sworn December 1, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
